guardrails.rationale: The prompt hook runs deterministic gate review on each user prompt and injects required Prism context without claiming prompt blocking as task intake.
Old-disease language is evaluated by the prompt gate before a turn proceeds.
Completion-claim language is routed through the prompt gate; explicit completion metadata remains CLI-enforced.
Diagnostic-only progress claims are evaluated at prompt time and remain hard-gated in CLI intake.

The prompt hook routes RedCap self-development through lifecycle checking, and lifecycle checking now blocks unresolved Prism concern/block merges before implementation can proceed; Stop also reruns redcap check self-probes.
The Stop hook runs redcap check, which includes hook coverage validation before the turn can close cleanly.
The Stop hook correlates required UserPromptSubmit markers with same-turn PostToolUse action evidence and blocks explanation-only closes.
The Stop hook runs redcap check, and redcap check runs layout-check.
The Stop hook runs redcap check, and redcap check now runs the minimal session ownership self-check.
The Stop hook runs redcap check, and redcap check now runs the minimal executable FSM kernel.
The Stop hook runs redcap check, and redcap check now validates the index-first knowledge gateway.
The Stop hook runs redcap check, and redcap check runs boundary check plus boundary self-check so runtime/project/user boundary leaks cannot close cleanly.
The Stop hook runs redcap check, and redcap check validates bounded old-RedCap archaeology shards instead of accepting unbounded scanning or undocumented extraction.
The prompt hook runs Prism gate, and Prism gate now requires and checks lifecycle packets for medium-or-higher RedCap self-development work; Stop still runs redcap check for the self-check path.
The Stop hook checks the final assistant message and blocks completion claims for required RedCap prompts unless a fresh verified task-body lifecycle completion marker exists.
Provider follow-up continuity is enforced by the Prism dispatcher and verified by redcap check, which the Stop hook runs.
The provider dispatcher self-check is part of redcap check, which the Stop hook runs.
UserPromptSubmit runs the deterministic Prism gate with codex hook tags, and prism gate now appends a gate-evaluation record to the Prism ledger.
SessionStart attempts a real Cap soul load and records the result in the live marker; redcap check also verifies the loader.
Host hook capability is audited by redcap check, which the Stop hook runs; unsupported provider-host hooks are reported as audit facts instead of fake parity.
SessionStart is a real Codex project hook with a live-marker probe.
UserPromptSubmit is a real Codex project hook with a gate-decision live marker.
PreToolUse is a real Codex project hook that blocks known destructive commands and claims mutating session ownership.
Stop is a real Codex project hook that attempts redcap check and records live-marker evidence.
PostToolUse is a real Codex project hook that records same-turn supported tool-use fingerprints for Stop enforcement.

future_hook_policy.reason: Any future capability marked hook-required must name a required event, a deployed Codex hook, an operational matrix hook entry, and a live-marker probe before RedCap check can pass.
